**Clinical Summary:**  
A pediatric patient presents with early-onset (age 2 months), recurrent skin lesions, recurrent respiratory tract infections, and recurrent fevers — consistent with a severe, inherited phagocytic immunodeficiency. Laboratory evaluation reveals leukocytosis with left shift and a **confirmed abnormal Nitroblue Tetrazolium (NBT) test**, indicating defective neutrophil oxidative burst. This finding, in conjunction with the clinical phenotype, is highly suggestive of **chronic granulomatous disease (CGD)**.
